column1: # mapping_set_description: Manually curated alignment of the Mellea LinkML schema (linkml/src/mellea/schema/mellea.yaml) to the ISO/IEC 27001 LinkML schema (linkml/src/mellea/mappings/iso27001/). Subjects are Mellea schema elements (classes and enum permissible values); objects are ISMS concepts from the iso27001 schema. Mappings are mostly skos:relatedMatch -- Mellea is an AI runtime/code architecture, while ISO 27001 is an information security management standard, so the alignments centre on observability, audit, and policy/requirement primitives that show up in both worlds.

column8: Mellea RequirementSpec validates runtime output against a constraint; ISO 27001 SecurityControl is a policy-level safeguard. Name collision on "requirement/control" with different enforcement layers.
Both express a target/constraint that needs to be met. Runtime validation vs management-system objective.
Plugins encapsulate reusable procedural logic invoked at lifecycle events; OperationalProcedure is the documented procedure analogue at the management-system level.
Audit-mode plugins observe runtime activity for governance/compliance; InternalAudit is the ISMS audit activity.
Validation-post-check hook payloads carry a pass/fail finding from a runtime control; AuditFinding is the documented finding from an ISMS audit.
Both name a measurable quantity tracked by a monitoring programme.
Mellea telemetry is the runtime monitoring programme; ISO MonitoringProgram is the documented monitoring activity at the management-system level.
Hook payloads describe observed runtime events; ISO InformationSecurityEvent describes observed security-relevant occurrences.
RepositoryCatalog is a structured, dated documentation of the analysed code; DocumentedInformation is the ISMS term for controlled, dated documents.
CLI commands codify operational steps an engineer runs; OperationalProcedure documents such steps at the ISMS level.
Both describe a process that orchestrates a sequence of steps; semantics differ significantly.
Both are the abstract root carrying id/name on every concrete subclass.
